title: caucalis gummifera
intro: Caucalis gummifera, commonly known as Sticky Mouse-ear, is a perennial plant belonging to the Apiaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Caucalis gummifera include its ability to reduce fever, relieve respiratory issues, and alleviate digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
